# SensorDataSynchronization

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The alignment of timing and spatial references across multiple sensor modalities to enable coherent joint analysis. Relevant to TCC because topology-aware data routing and synchronization are foundational for distributed in-network processing.
